title: The Jedi Pursuers above Coruscant
front_description: Smashing through Padmé's window, Obi-Wan grabs hold of the departing assassin droid and hangs onto it for dear life, dangling a hundred above the city. Anakin instantly appropriates a speeder and zooms after Obi-Wan. He deftly catches his falling mentor in the back seat after bounty hunter Zam Wesell blasts the assassin droid to smithereens. Soon both Jedi are pursuing Zam through the perilous skyscraper canyons of Coruscant.
back_description: Hayden Christensen and Ewan McGregor in the full-size speeder prop.
